title: F1: Cargo workspace skeleton + hid link layer + JSON output
description: Create the Rust CLI skeleton for `omg`. Deps: clap(derive), anyhow, thiserror, hidapi=2.6, serde, serde_json. Port the Link trait + HidLink + transfer() from ../oh-my-gravastar-upstream/orbit-gravastar/src/hid.rs (85 lines, MIT). Global flags: --json (serde_json output for every command), --device <path|vid:pid> (auto-select when exactly one match), exit codes 0 ok / 1 error / 2 no-device / 3 unsupported. Implement `omg devices` that enumerates hidapi device_list and reports any device matching known GravaStar identities: keyboard v2 (VID 1CA6/31E3, usage 0xFFB0), SparkPlayJoy (usage 0xFFA0), mouse Compx (VID 3554 PIDs F54B F575 F548 F577 F576 F549, usage 0xFF02), khub916 wired (VID 258A PID 010C and table in docs/plan.md) + 916_wireLess table. Output must include vid, pid, product string, usage page, path. Unit test: mock device list. This is the foundation every other bead builds on.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build+clippy+test clean; workspace has crates/{hid,proto-he,proto-mouse,proto-khub916,model,omg}; omg devices lists K1 Pro (258A:010C); --json works; pushed to GitHub
close_reason: Workspace skeleton + hid layer + omg devices done, K1 Pro detected, pushed

title: F5a: Reverse khub916 HID engine from vendor JS
description: Main research task. Deobfuscate docs/research/khub-webapp/index-M8-m9qFR.js (207KB, string-table obfuscation s(NNN) lookups, sendFeatureReport queue). Goals: (1) HID device selection criteria (collections with outputReports>0 && featureReports>0), (2) report ID used, (3) packet envelope format (header, length, checksum, sequence), (4) auth/password handshake using per-model password (K1 = 0x0300000001b4, protocolKey 916), (5) command IDs for: device info, layout/keymap read, lighting get/set, key remap, macro, profile. Cross-reference chunk files (devicesInit, home, screensInit, BasicFunctions, LightingEffect, MacroConfiguration, AdvancedKey, ConfigurationManagement) for call sites. Document findings in docs/protocol-khub916.md BEFORE writing Rust code. Verify read-only commands against the live K1 Pro (VID 258A PID 010C, currently connected via USB cable). Safety: until a command is proven read-only, do not send it from Rust; probe via a scratch script only.
acceptance_criteria: docs/protocol-khub916.md exists with: transport+report IDs, packet envelope+checksum (verified), auth/password flow, command table with byte layouts, device ID tables; docs/research/khub916-notes.md with methodology; verified-vs-inferred marked per section

Port semantics from the JS reference, not byte-for-byte guesses. Include captured-packet fixtures from the live K1 Pro in tests/.

title: F4: Port Compx mouse protocol + CLI
description: Port crates/proto-mouse from ../oh-my-gravastar-upstream/orbit-gravastar/src/protocol/mouse.rs (476 lines, MIT, has unit tests to port). Spec: docs in upstream docs/protocol-mouse.md. Transport: VID 0x3554, dongle PIDs F54B F575 F548 F577, wired F576 F549, usage page 0xFF02, report id 8, 16-byte payload [cmd,status,addrHi,addrLo,len,data*10,cksum]; checksum = (0x08 + sum bytes 0..14) & 0xFF == 0x55 i.e. byte15 = (0x4D - sum) & 0xFF. One request in flight; mouse may push unsolicited 0x0A reports. Commands: 01 identify (CID 18=GravaStar; MID 1-2 PAW3395 26k DPI, MID 3-5 PAW3950 32k), 03 online, 04 battery (voltage->percent table of 21 entries), 07 write flash, 08 read flash, 0E profile, 12 mouse fw, 1D dongle fw. Flash map: polling@0, stage count@2, current@4, LOD@10, DPI@12+4i, DPI color@44+4i, buttons@96+4i, light@160, debounce@169, motion sync@171, sleep@173 (x10s units 1,3,6,12,18,30,60,90), angle snap@175, ripple@177, light-off-moving@179, sensor mode@185. Scalars stored as [v, 0x55-v]; records end with check byte summing to 0x55. WRITABLE allowlist of 15 ranges - refuse everything else. NEVER implement: 05/06 pairing, 09 factory reset, 31 RF, B0-B7 bootloader. CLI: omg mouse info|battery|fw|config|get|set <field> --yes; DPI encode (raw=dpi/50-1 or /100-1 high range), clamp per sensor; wireless wake handling per OmaGravastar research/wake_and_battery.py. mouse-protocol/src/drivers/gravastar/hid.ts has TS reference + products.ts ID table. Unit tests: packet checksum vectors, DPI roundtrip, voltage curve (port from upstream tests).
close_reason: proto-mouse + omg mouse CLI done, 18 tests pass, pushed 0fc7808

title: F6: SparkPlayJoy 6x21 analog travel reader
description: Depends F2+F1. Implement crates/proto-sparkplayjoy (new crate or module in proto-he) per docs/protocol-sparkplayjoy.md (research agent writes it; fallback: HallJoy/docs/research/GRAVASTAR_MERCURY_V75_FIRMWARE_STATIC_ANALYSIS_2026-08-22.md + aula_win60he_protocol.h/.cpp in ../oh-my-gravastar-upstream/HallJoy). Framed protocol on usage 0xFFA0:0001: request 5C <len> <cmd> <cksum> <payload>; response cmd = request|0x80; checksum low byte of (35+0x5C+len+cmd+last-payload-byte); long responses continue over multiple 64-byte reports (65-byte Win32 buffer, report id 0). Read-only commands: sync 01, scale order 0x25 (precision 5um, min 5um, max ~3500um read live), default map 0x2B (2 rows x 21 factory key ids), active map 0x23 (14 x 4-byte queries -> function records), live travel 0x12 selector 02 half 01/02 -> 63 u16 samples each half = 6x21 matrix. Identity gate: only exact board IDs 16052201 (1CA5:2201 V75), 16052202 (1CA5:2202 V75 Pro), 2E022201 (1CA2:2201 V75 Lite) auto-claim; unknown 6x21 candidates require structural proof only. Fn function = 0xF001 -> extended keycode 0x409; Menu = HID 0x0065; never truncate Fxxx. CLI: omg kb travel-matrix [--watch] --json emitting {row,col,travel_um,actuated}. Verify on HE keyboard; if none available mark hardware-pending in code docs.
acceptance_criteria: docs/protocol-sparkplayjoy.md exists [DONE by research]; crates/proto-sparkplayjoy decodes sync/scale/map/travel; omg kb travel-matrix --json works or documented hardware-pending

title: F7: Unified profile export/import (JSON schema v1)
description: Depends F3+F4+F5c. JSON schema v1: {schema:1, exported_at, devices:[{protocol: khub916|he-v2|compx, vid, pid, model?, profiles:[...]}]}. Per-device profile capture = all readable settings (kb: keymap+perf+lighting+polling+os; khub916: whatever F5c exposes; mouse: full MouseConfig). omg profile export <file> collects from all connected devices; import <file> validates schema+device match (vid/pid + protocol), backs up current to ~/.local/share/oh-my-gravastar/backups/<ts>/ first, writes via each proto's verified setters, --dry-run supported. Reference: OmaGravastar helpers/omagravastarctl export/import (web-driver .bin format - optional compat later, JSON is canonical). Unit tests with fixture JSON roundtrip.

title: F8: omg probe raw diagnostic command
description: Like orbit --probe (upstream src/cli.rs run_inner/probe_keyboard/probe_mouse): for each detected device dump identity + every readable field + raw reply hex (first N bytes). Read-only only. --json supported. Purpose: safe addition of new models - capture replies, diff against known devices, extend ID tables. Must never send unproven writes.

title: F10: Offline web UI / PWA via WebHID (phase 3)
description:
Only if demanded after CLI mature. Two options evaluated in plan.md: (a) Vite+React+TS PWA using WebHID - natural for khub916 since vendor app is already WebHID, and mouse-protocol proves Compx works in browser; (b) wasm build of the Rust proto crates. khub916 is WebHID-native so browser support is a differentiator. Serve as static site, fully offline. Depends F5c protocol being stable enough to port.
